cards.card_text: His strength is dried up like a potsherd, and his tongue sticks to the roof of his mouth.
cards.verse_text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD tells Jeremiah to go out to the Valley of Ben-hinnom, near the entrance of the Potsherd Gate, and proclaim His words there.
